name: TikTok Ads weekly account keeper
why: Runs the weekly TikTok review from your export: each ad called keep, fix or stop.

name: Weekly video ad batch maker
why: Makes a weekly batch of video ad scripts from last week's results.

name: Five-tactic ad hook writer
why: Writes ranked hooks for the first seconds of each ad, ready for a hook test.

name: Short video hook writer
why: More opening lines for short vertical video, to widen the hook bank.

name: Five-part creator ad script writer
why: Turns a creator brief into a timed script from hook to call to action.

name: Creator ad roster builder
why: Plans a roster of creators for Spark Ads, with a brief and flat pay rule.

name: Creator pay planner
why: Works out a fair fee for a creator post, for the client to approve and pay.

name: Organic post to ad promoter
why: Picks which organic posts are worth promoting as ads, the starting point for Spark Ads.

name: Ad test budget calculator
why: Sets daily spend and how much to spend before judging a hook test.

name: Creative test reader
why: Reads test results by ad and flags false winners before budget moves.

name: Ad fatigue watcher
why: Catches tired ads early so fresh hooks are briefed in time.

name: GMV Max campaign setup planner
why: Plans a GMV Max set-up for brands that sell through TikTok Shop.

name: Monthly tracking health keeper
why: A monthly check that catches broken Pixel or Events API set-ups and double counts.
